description: This file defines the class SharedStorageImplementation, which implements multiple interfaces related to shared storage management, including configuration, notification, cache, and limit controls. It includes nested classes, method declarations for setting/getting/deleting storage data, and event dispatching mechanisms.

classes.name: Store2Notification
classes.description: Nested class implementing IStore2::INotification to handle value change events.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Nested class representing asynchronous jobs for event dispatching.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the shared storage implementation with the provided service.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a value in shared storage with specified scope, namespace, key, value, and TTL.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value from shared storage.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key from shared storage.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes an entire namespace from shared storage.

methods.name: SetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: GetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: getRemoteStoreObject
methods.description: Returns a remote store object for a given scope.

methods.name: ValueChanged
methods.description: Handles value change events and notifies observers.
